scope: Audit of the existing Composio integration against the official v3.1 documentation, and an opt-in, default-off extension: explicit instant:false on every session with verification and repair of stored sessions, firewall hooks, multi-account with ownership proof, a gated remote workbench, and budget-ledger-bound paid Instant execution. No Composio call was made; nothing is enabled in production.

keep: Existing REST v3.1 client, session ownership assertion, discovery re-check and authority-permit action path
Existing signed webhook receiver and trigger flow
Canonical scheduler, tenant context and provider budget ledger
extend: Session creation and verification gain a pure policy module (instant, hooks, workbench, multi-account)
New fixedCostBudget.ts module reuses the existing reserve, settle and release routines for per-call spend; providerBudget.ts is unchanged
Account selection for reads, actions and triggers when multi-account is enabled
replace: validateSafeRuntimeConfig is replaced by the policy module, which checks a superset of the same rules

schemaImpact.rollout: Additive: one owner-RLS table holding only a Composio connected-account id. Not applied by this change; nothing reads it until XROGA_COMPOSIO_MULTI_ACCOUNT is enabled.
schemaImpact.rollback: DROP TABLE public.composio_default_accounts (nothing else references it).

auth.description: New accounts routes sit behind the existing integrations authentication; identity comes only from the verified request user.

tenant.description: Connected-account listing is filtered by the caller Composio user id and PRIVATE accounts only; a request-supplied account id is used only if it is in that fresh list; SHARED connections are never treated as connected.

approval.description: Instant and Workbench execution each need a current single-use authority permit bound to the exact tool and arguments or code; both are off by default and have no user-facing route.

credentials.description: No new credential is stored or logged. Provider output is redacted by the existing redaction path and bounded.

egress.description: Workbench sessions request egress restricted to Composio at creation (not verifiable by read-back); the default workbench stays disabled.

cost.description: Paid Instant is explicitly disabled on every session and can run only with a configured per-call ceiling, an allowlist and a ledger reservation made before the call.

billing.description: No payment or subscription path changes.

tests.scope: Session policy, stored-session verification and repair, firewall block handling, multi-account isolation, Instant ceiling and ledger behaviour, workbench gating.
Webhook signature vectors from the documented algorithm, trigger account pinning, accounts routes.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing Composio client, authority permits and provider budget ledger. No scheduler, agent framework, SDK dependency or authentication system is added.

rollout: Merge only after review and your authorization. Then, as separate approved steps: apply the migration to a disposable database and verify, provide a Composio test project key, run the live checks in the status document, and only then consider enabling any flag.
rollback: Leave every XROGA_COMPOSIO_* variable unset (the default). Revert the change to remove the code.
knownGaps: No live Composio call was made: every wire shape comes from the published documentation and a stub
The stored hooks read-back shape and the egress restriction read-back are not documented precisely
No user-facing Instant or Workbench route; Instant and Workbench have no caller
Chat does not ask which account to use: with several accounts and no saved default it stops and says to choose a default
The default-account table and the durable fixed-cost ledger are not exercised against a real PostgreSQL
A held Instant reservation is released by an operator after comparing Composio execution logs
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Live Composio behaviour for sessions, hooks, Instant, multi-account and the workbench is unverified

blockers: No approved Composio test project and API key for live verification
Instant and Firewall require Composio project and plan settings that need approval
Authenticated end-to-end and staged security proof not run for this change
